blocks.content: To find out the nth number in the Fibonacci sequence, we need to find the sum of the (n - 1)th and (n - 2)th numbers.
As such, we need to recursively call two methods by passing n - 1 and n - 2 as arguments, and then add the return values of these two methods.
Here, fib() is the recursive method to find the nth Fibonacci number.
The first two terms of the series are always 0 and 1. So, for the first two terms, we can simply return 0 and 1, respectively (base case).
